reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1 skipped (missing-validation finding — issue is absence of admin check inside the RPC, not unreachable code). Gate 2: BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json has no trust_assumptions; entry point is an authenticated non-admin PostgREST call (untrusted). Gate 3: src/app/api/ is in scope; admin privilege escalation is a listed key concern. Attack path: an authenticated non-admin user can POST /rest/v1/rpc/delete_application with {"p_id": "<target-client-id>"} and their Supabase JWT, invoking the RPC as the authenticated role and bypassing the Next.js admin gate entirely. Confirmed potential (not full confirmation) because no SQL migration files exist to verify whether delete_application grants EXECUTE to the authenticated role or contains an internal auth.uid()/is_admin guard — the asymmetry with delete_user_consent (which passes p_user_id for DB-level enforcement) strongly suggests the guard is absent.
